rule: Spelling and grammar in text the game prints, requested 2026-11-03. Includes wrong words (TO for TOO, WILL for WHILE), missing apostrophes and missing words. People's surnames and the EMPATH and VOC. column abbreviations stay. Logic, line numbers and every other byte are unchanged; line pointers are recomputed with the original memory base.

changes.from: WHO IS BEST COACH OF THE PLANET
changes.to: WHO IS THE BEST COACH ON PLANET
changes.layout: ON PLANET offsets the added THE, keeping the line at 63 columns

changes.from: GO THOUGH ALL THE TEAMS PLEASE
changes.to: GO THROUGH ALL THE TEAMS. PLEASE

changes.layout: THROUGH and the period add two columns, so two fewer pads keep NAME at the start of the next row

changes.to: NOW WE WILL GO THROUGH THE

changes.layout: One more pad keeps the field's length
TOO is one letter longer, so one fewer pad keeps WEEK'S at the start of the next row

changes.from: THIS IS THIRD WEEK, AND THE LAST
changes.to: THIS IS THE THIRD WEEK, THE LAST
changes.layout: Dropping AND offsets the added THE; the longer line would be 64 columns, which prints a blank line

changes.from: GO TO AUDUTORIUM WILL WE TABLUATE
changes.to: GO TO THE AUDITORIUM WHILE WE TABULATE
